phase: Reference Mode Recovery — Sectoral Financial Positions / Phase B exact aggregate identity
purpose: Test a mathematically equivalent QSA aggregate route to the exact RMD F2-F8 sectoral boundary after Phase A showed that eight individual component series are not disseminated. Phase B uses directly published total financial instruments F and explicitly removes F1 where required; it may not reinterpret unavailable Phase A components as zero.

methodological_basis.ESA2010: Financial transactions/assets are classified into F1 through F8; monetary gold and SDRs are F1, while the RMD represented boundary is F2-F8.

H.basis: Households/NPISH are not monetary authorities or official SDR holders. If a QSA F1 series is nevertheless published, it must be finite and zero within tolerance or the gate fails.

C.basis: Non-financial corporations are not monetary authorities or official SDR holders. If a QSA F1 series is nevertheless published, it must be finite and zero within tolerance or the gate fails.

F.basis: No assumption is made that F1 cancels. The subtraction is evaluated explicitly from published S12 and S121 F1 series.

G.basis: ESA monetary authorities can include central-government institutions in some institutional arrangements; Romania S13 F1 is therefore not assumed zero.

BNR.basis: Central-bank F1 is in scope and must be removed explicitly.

X.basis: External F1 positions are published separately and must be removed explicitly before reversing the rest-of-world orientation.

source.api: ECB Data Portal SDMX 2.1 REST API

construction.H: W0 S1M total F; optional published F1 is a contradiction check and, if present, is subtracted only after passing zero-within-tolerance.
construction.C: W0 S11 total F; optional published F1 is a contradiction check and, if present, is subtracted only after passing zero-within-tolerance.
construction.G: W0 S13 F - W0 S13 F1.
construction.X: For W1 S1/S1, compute resident external F-F1 separately for A and L; set X assets = resident external liabilities and X liabilities = resident external assets.
construction.stock_and_flow: Apply the same exact identity independently to LE stocks and F financial transactions; never difference stocks to create flows.

consistency_gates.system_identity: sum H+C+F+G+BNR+X net represented position/transactions must reconcile to zero on the F2-F8 boundary.

promotion_rule: Promote sectoral_financial_positions only if all mandatory total-F and mandatory-F1 source series are finite over at least 40 common quarters including all 2025 quarters, H/C F1 contradiction checks pass, the exact same-period formulas produce all six sectors for both stock and flow, and both system reconciliation gates pass within 0.1 million RON. Promotion changes only aggregate reference-mode observability; bilateral Accounting Spine readiness and behavioural closure remain unchanged.
negative_result_rule: Any mandatory F/F1 source gap, nonzero contradiction to the preregistered H/C F1 applicability rule, benchmark gap, insufficient common history or system-reconciliation failure leaves the mode PARTIAL. Phase A component gaps may not be patched directly.
